properties_coordinates_pair.name: properties_coordinates_pair
properties_coordinates_pair.value: ("properties"."latitude" is null and "properties"."longitude" is null) or ("properties"."latitude" is not null and "properties"."longitude" is not null and "properties"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "properties"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

generated.as: status not in ('Cancelled', 'Rejected') and reservation_kind not in ('inquiry', 'online_failed')

bookings_kind_matches_status.name: bookings_kind_matches_status
bookings_kind_matches_status.value: ("bookings"."status"::text <> 'Pending' or "bookings"."reservation_kind" in ('inquiry', 'online_failed', 'hold_unconfirm')) and ("bookings"."status"::text not in ('Approved', 'CheckedIn', 'CheckedOut', 'NoShow') or "bookings"."reservation_kind" in ('confirm', 'hold_confirm'))

stay_registrations_form_c_submitted.name: stay_registrations_form_c_submitted
stay_registrations_form_c_submitted.value: "stay_registrations"."form_c_status" <> 'submitted' or ("stay_registrations"."form_c_reference" is not null and "stay_registrations"."form_c_submitted_at" is not null)

folio_charges_levy_night_uq.name: folio_charges_levy_night_uq
folio_charges_levy_night_uq.where: "folio_charges"."levy_code" is not null and "folio_charges"."voided_at" is null

folio_charges_levy_night.name: folio_charges_levy_night
folio_charges_levy_night.value: "folio_charges"."levy_code" is null or "folio_charges"."booking_date" is not null
